reviews.comment:
phil 320:The class lectures were very engaging, Dr H-P is an amazing professor! attendance is mandatory, but he made going to class fun! he had “surprise quizzes” which were very easy as long as you did the readings
he's very flexible with deadlines if you talk to him in advance and he grades in a timely fashion & always replies emails fast

WOW Dr. H-P was amazing. He is such a caring professor and truly understands that his students have lives. His lectures are so interesting and you learn so much, and his tests are easy. My favorite professor at A&M so far and such an interesting class to challenge your ways of thinking. Would take this class again if I could, DR H-P on top!

Dr. HP is awesome and could not recommend him more!!! He cares deeply about his students and their success, exhorting them and encouraging them to think deeply while pursuing excellence. He makes an A extremely achievable and it is joyful to attend class. His lectures are interesting and engaging, and would highly encourage this class!!!!!!!!!!!!

Dr. H-P is one of the most caring and funny professors I have had so far. Although attendance is mandatory, he mostly keeps you entertained throughout the lectures. He is very funny and wants all of his students to succeed. His exams are straightforward from the study guides, and he gives a review before every exam.

Dr. H-P is a great professor and a great person. Lectures branch out a lot as questions are asked about the topic, but the exams are not reflective of that. Just focus on the study guides and you'll be good. Can't recommend this class enough! It is very interesting.

Professor H-P is fantastic, I am taking him again for PHIL320! The class is very lecture-heavy, so don't miss but you can miss up to 3 unexcused before it affects your grade. There are two exams, one final, two papers, and one video presentation. The tests are online, but you go to class to take them. Please take him and his classes if you can!!
Awesome prof, made sure to explain confusing topics really well. Go to class, don't have to do the readings to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Philosophy can be very confusing, but he makes sure to clearly explain the concepts in an easy to understand way. Exams were in class, so you definitely have to study.

Dr. HP is great! He is so sweet and understanding. I will say the class is VERY lecture heavy so dont miss. The topics can be difficult to understand but hopefully the papers and the extra credit save you. 2 exams, 1 final, 2 papers, 1 video presentation. Test is online but IN CLASS. attendance is required and graded.

Nicest guy ever, he's so sweet and doesn't give barely any homework. Tests are open resource. You don't have to go to class, but he takes attendance everyday as part of your grade, but lectures where good so I didn't mind going. He isn't picky about anything.

Super nice guy and easy grader! Graded on attendance, 2 papers, 3 tests, and 1 video presentation. As long as you attend class and read the notes you can easily make an A. Tests are online, papers are graded generously, attendance isn't weighed too heavily. Made a core curriculum class enjoyable and interesting. 10/10

I am actually taking him for PHIL 320 right now and he is such a nice & caring professor. He makes the class easy to understand although the subject may be hard (it is philosophy after all). Please please take him, he is also very understanding when it comes to deadlines.

Actually had a really fun and engaging class and was very understanding of circumstances, he even accepts late work and pushes due dates back if need be. He's probably one of the most understanding professors ever. I recommend taking him if you like exploring opinions on different matters.
Dr. HP is very funny and the class is engaging. Very Easy A. Just show up to class and do good on the papers. Don't worry the papers are very easy.

SUPER cool and chill professor. He grades fairly and respects his students' opinions. He's also very considerate of personal circumstances, such as his due dates aligning with exams for other classes (he pushes dates back!). However, attendance and participation is a grade so show up! No final, 1 exam, 2 papers, 1 presentation.
